title: EternaSMP
description: A feature-rich SMP with custom enchants, 6 jobs, 29 ranks, and unique items. Build your legacy on EternaSMP.
body:
Welcome to EternaSMP

EternaSMP is a feature-packed survival multiplayer server built for players who want more than vanilla Minecraft. Whether you're a grinder, a builder, or an explorer there's something here for you.

Jobs & Economy
Earn in-game money by doing what you love. Choose from 6 jobs — Miner, Digger, Woodcutter, Fisherman, Hunter, and Farmer. The higher your job level, the more you earn. With a max level of 500, there's always something to grind toward.

🏆 Rank Progression
Work your way through 29 unique ranks, each unlocking new commands, homes, job slots, and perks. From Novice all the way to Immortal. Your progression is entirely earned in-game.

✨ Custom Enchants
Go beyond vanilla enchanting with exclusive custom enchantments.

🗡️ Custom Items
Discover unique items you won't find anywhere else in vanilla Minecraft.

🌍 Two Worlds
A dedicated main world for building and a separate resource world for gathering. Keeping your builds safe while giving you unlimited resources to collect.

🌀 Player Warps
Browse community-made player warps for XP, money, and resources. Perfect for new players getting started.
